name: Pruna (Spain)
description: Light green field with a yellow horizontal stripe across the centre and a light blue triangle with its base along the hoist, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Pruna (chequy of yellow and green, and a castle on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Pruna; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
